questions.text: Is backfill allowed to write directly to the store, or only through ingest?
Does the scheduler dropping a batch when the store lock is held conflict with the exactly-once / idempotent-retry invariant, given dropped batches are not retried?
Why does config/defaults.json define timeout_seconds at all if the production timeout is set by the platform team?
Which retention value is authoritative: the 30 days in config/defaults.json or the 45 days hardcoded in src/retention.js?
Is the silent truncation in backfill intentional, or should oversized backfills be rejected like ingest does?
Does src/store.js read config/defaults.json, or is the config file currently unwired?
Where is the ADR-001 document itself, and was the fixed-vs-sliding decision made with 30 or 45 days in mind?
Does the ingest MAX_BATCH of 100 intentionally mirror config batch_size, or is one expected to change?
